# OWASP Juice Shop Setup & Testing

## Project Overview
This project demonstrates the setup, reconnaissance, and exploitation of multiple vulnerabilities in the OWASP Juice Shop application.

## Vulnerabilities Covered
- SQL Injection Authentication Bypass
- DOM-based Cross-Site Scripting (XSS)
- Broken Access Control
- Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR)
- Forged Feedback / Improper Authorization

## Tools Used
- Nmap
- Dirb
- Burp Suite
- OWASP Juice Shop

## Generated Files
### 1. HTML Report
`OWASP_JuiceShop_Setup_&_Testing.html`

Features:
- Fully self-contained
- All images embedded using Base64
- No external dependencies
- Image positions preserved from the original document

## Usage
Open the HTML file in any browser.

## Notes
This HTML file can be shared independently without requiring separate image files.
